objective: To let the VPLD Planner create the Daily Trucking Plan (DTP) per planning date with one Universal DTP model for Import and Export.
To collect delivery records from Excel upload, manual entry and the IPMS interface in one grid, validate them and submit the selected records.
To send submitted records to a processing queue (UISS-Batch "DTP Creation - Queue Processing"); processed records become Daily orders for the LP Admin.
To show per date and trucking company the Master KPI Order Sharing limit, the assigned DTP and the remaining slot (DTP Creation vs Master KPI).
To roll back submitted DTP records while the driver has not started (DTP Switching), so they can be corrected and submitted again.
To maintain the DTP of a planning date and DTP type from the calendar (DTP n List): change data, or cancel / delete one or many DTP at once, as long as the driver has not started.
To show per date the By Trip trip limit, the trips by trip and the remaining trips per trucking company (Master KPI Payment Type By Trip).
To let the planner choose the Payment Type (By Resources / By Trip) of each DTP, so that the slot monitoring and the Daily order follow the chosen type.

operation.text: 5.1 DTP Calendar (DT-01, DT-02)
Month view by default; Week / Day views; Previous / Next / Today.
Selectable range = today - DTP_BACKDATE_DAYS ... today + DTP_ADVANCE_DAYS (System Master (TB_M_SYSTEM, TBD); mock-up 3 / 14, TBD OP-01). Not configured: no date selectable, message no. 1.
Day cell states: Selectable, Disabled (outside range; click shows the reason), Today, Selected. Badge 'n open · n in queue' for DTP records not processed.
Click a selectable date -> Universal DTP selection -> Next opens DTP Creation; the date is kept in the URL and header.
Non-Planner users can browse the calendar and grid read only.
5.2 Calendar Entries
One entry per date + DTP type of the Daily orders: 'DTP - U ( dd/mm/yyyy ) [ assigned / total ]'; max 6 per cell, '+n more' opens the Day view.

rows: All orders Finish / SA Approved / SA Approved with PO
Any order rejected by LP and still Planning Order

operation.text: Click: Daily Monitoring filtered on the date (and DTP type).
5.3 Record Status (DT-13, DT-15)
5.4 Excel Upload (DT-11)
Choose File (.xlsx / .xls) starts the upload with the header Operation Type; loading indicator. Processing: refer UISS-Batch "DTP Creation - Excel Upload".
Result: success -> records added as Available, message no. 22; file error -> message no. 18 / 19 / 20; row errors -> nothing added, dialog Row / Column / Error (downloadable), message no. 21.
Download Template: sheets 'Format DTP' (header in row 7 as format_DTP2_1.xlsx) and 'DATA MAPPING' (message no. 23).
5.5 Record Validation (Manual Entry, Edit, IPMS; same rules as upload)

items: Mandatory: Import/Export, ROUNDUSE, LP, RENBAN, FROM, TO, DESTINATION, ETD, CONTAINER SIZE, TRUCK TYPE (no. 6).
Options: ROUNDUSE Y/N; CONTAINER SIZE 20/40/40 HC/45; SHIFT DAY/NIGHT; CTR DG FLAG DG (no. 7).
LP, FROM, TO in the data mapping; TO <> FROM (no. 8 / 9).
RENBAN, DESTINATION, CTR BOOKING NO, IMPORTER CD letters / numbers max 20 (no. 10); dates / time valid (no. 11).
Duplicate key Container No, else Ctr Booking No: not in the grid, not submitted, Failed excluded (no. 13 / 14) (TBD OP-03).

operation.text: IPMS records that fail stay in the grid as Validation Error (never dropped) and cannot be deleted; Edit re-validates them.
5.6 Interface Data (IPMS)
Records of the date received by the interface (UISS-Batch, TBD OP-07) appear in the grid with Data Source 'IPMS Interface'. Load / Refresh asks for new records; error: message no. 26.
5.7 Select and Submit (DT-13 to DT-16)

items: Only Available / Ready to Submit rows can be selected; Select All = all eligible rows of the current filter.
Submit DTP (n) is disabled without selection. Confirmation message no. 28 with planning date, count (Import / Export) and the warning.
Confirm: one transaction - re-check STATUS = READY and VERSION, set SUBMITTED, write history, send to the queue. Any error: rollback, records unchanged and still selected (no. 30).
Success: message no. 31; the rows become non-selectable at once. Because the status is stored, a refresh cannot submit them again.

operation.text: 5.8 Queue and Result

UISS-Batch "DTP Creation - Queue Processing": Submitted -> Queued -> Processing -> Processed (Daily order: Planning Order / DTP Creation Release, visible for the LP Admin) or Failed (reason on the badge).
Retry on a Failed record: status Queued again (message no. 32). The grid refreshes automatically while records are in the queue.
5.9 Reject by LP (Daily Monitoring)
LP Admin can reject an order in Planning Order without truck (reason >= 10 characters); the calendar shows Rejected by LP; Assign Truck / Order Release are blocked (TBD OP-09).
5.10 Security and Audit
Create actions only for VPLD Planner (authorization configuration). History per record status change; audit fields on every change.
5.11 DTP Creation vs Master KPI (KM-01 to KM-08)
Calculated per planning date shown and per trucking company; dates are never combined. Rows: LP codes of the DTP data mapping plus any LP found in the records of the date.

Limit = Order Sharing of the applicable Master KPI row (one current row per company; with an effective period: date within effective from - to, TBD). Payment Type must be 'By Resources'. No row: 'No Master KPI' (limit not assumed 0).
Unit: Order Sharing = daily order share (daily QTY of PR Creation); one DTP record = one Daily order, so Assigned = number of DTP records of the date and LP that consume the allocation.
Consuming: Submitted, Queued, Processing, Processed, Failed. Not consuming: Available, Ready to Submit, Validation Error, rolled back (DTP Switching), Processed and rejected by the LP Admin (TBD).
Remaining = max(0, Limit - Assigned); Over Allocation = Assigned - Limit when > 0 (shown, never hidden). Usage % = Assigned / Limit x 100.
Recalculated from the records on every change of the grid (select, submit, queue result, DTP Switching, LP reject) - no page reload.
Not blocking: DTP Creation has no limit rule; Submit shows a warning when After Submit exceeds the limit or the LP has no Master KPI (message no. 36).
5.12 DTP Switching (rollback, refer UISS-Batch DTP Switching)
Eligible: Submitted, Queued, Failed, and Processed with Daily order Planning Order / Order Release and no cycle Start Cycle. Not eligible: Processing, driver started, not submitted.
[DTP Switching] -> check latest status -> confirmation (message no. 41) -> backend re-check and rollback (one transaction, all-or-nothing) -> success message no. 37 -> grid and KPI monitor refreshed.
Errors: driver started (no. 38), no longer eligible (no. 39), DB failure (no. 40).
5.13 DTP Maintenance (MT-01 to MT-08)
Calendar entry click opens the list of the Daily orders of that date and DTP type. Values: DTP record (Universal DTP) or the order (older DTP 1-4).

MT-01: a row may be changed or deleted only while the driver has not started: order Planning Order / Order Release and no cycle with Start Cycle. MT-02: VPLD Planner only (message no. 51 for other roles).

MT-01a Multiple delete: check rows or Select All (current search, all pages, deletable rows only) -> [Delete Selected] marks all of them at once; [Restore Selected] removes the marks of the selected marked rows. No X button per row (rev 0.3). Nothing is deleted before Save.

MT-03: changes are validated at Save with the DTP Creation rules (mandatory, mapping codes, From <> To, formats, options; Ctr Size + Ctr Type = 20 / 40 / 40 HC / 45). Invalid: message no. 47, cells highlighted, nothing saved.

MT-04 / MT-05: Save -> confirmation -> backend re-check of the driver status of every row -> one transaction, all-or-nothing (as Submit DT-15). Driver started meanwhile: message no. 46, nothing saved. DB failure: message no. 48.

Delete: the Daily order is cancelled (hidden for LP Admin, Truck Assignment, Driver; truck released, driver sync REMOVE as DTP Switching) and the DTP record is deleted with history (MT-OQ1). Change: DTP record and Daily order updated, order history 'DTP Maintenance'.

MT-06: another Truck Company releases the truck and the LP decision (order back to Planning Order). MT-07: deleted DTP no longer consume the Master KPI Order Sharing. Success: message no. 45; list, calendar and KPI refreshed.
5.14 DTP Creation vs Master KPI - By Trip (KM-09 to KM-12)

KM-09: company with a By Resources row and a By Trip row: records up to the By Resources limit count by resource, the records above it count by trip (no over allocation). By Trip only company: all records by trip. By Resources only: over allocation as 5.11 e.
KM-10: Daily Trip = the part of the trips per day (Master KPI, default 20) of each eligible By Trip company (share > 0): 1 trip each, the rest by Order Sharing % (largest remainder).
KM-11: Remaining Trip = max(0, Daily Trip - Trips by trip); Over Limit shown; After Submit uses the same split for the selected records. Not blocking.
KM-12: Total By Trip of Master KPI must be 100.00%, otherwise message no. 52 above the table.
Both tables show Order Sharing % and Daily Trip (limit per day): By Resources Daily Trip is typed in Master KPI and its % is information only; By Trip Daily Trip is calculated from the trips per day.
5.15 Payment Type per DTP (KM-13 to KM-15)

KM-13: every DTP record has a Payment Type By Resources or By Trip chosen by the planner. Slot monitoring: By Resources table counts By Resources records (above the Daily Trip = over allocation), By Trip table counts By Trip records. Records without a type (older data) fill the By Resources Daily Trip first, the rest by trip.

KM-14: choices = payment types of the trucking company in Master KPI (By Trip only with Order Sharing > 0). Default for new / imported / edited records: By Resources while the company still has a free By Resources Daily Trip on the date, otherwise By Trip.

KM-15: change per row (column) or for the selected records (Payment Type ▾), in Manual Entry / Edit, only before submission (msg 55); after submission in DTP Maintenance while the driver has not started. Submit is blocked when a selected record of a company with Master KPI has no valid type (msg 53). The type is stored on the Daily order.
